sms.title: SMS code from ORLEN ID
sms.description: ORLEN now requires an SMS code to confirm the login. The code was sent to the number linked to account {login} and is valid for a few minutes only — if it expires, close this dialog and open it again to request a new one.

error.sms_code_invalid: The code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.sms_request_failed: Could not request an SMS code. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.reauth_successful: Signed in. Sensors have been refreshed.
abort.integration_not_loaded: The integration is not loaded — start it and try again.
